reentry.new_material_change: WP901 G4 persisted-row snapshot binding is now accepted at repository-hosted component-CI scope

source_observations.finding: After file-identity check and deterministic checkpoint serialization, the method executes BEGIN IMMEDIATE before existing-row and lineage reads and keeps validation/insert inside that write transaction.
source_observations.consequence: Do not insert data_version as a correctness authority into this path without a separately reproduced gap; SQLite write serialization is the stronger concurrency primitive.

source_observations.finding: The G4 recovery path rejects caller-owned transactions, checks stable file identity, starts BEGIN IMMEDIATE, re-reads checkpoint/recovery rows, validates digest/typed replay, and applies compare-and-swap before commit.
source_observations.consequence: An external revision hint is not a substitute for this transaction/CAS boundary and is likely redundant for recovery correctness unless a concrete pre-BEGIN stale-use defect is shown.

source_observations.finding: The method performs a fresh SELECT after file-identity checking and validates stored path/device/inode/authority receipt, JSON digest and typed replay. It does not establish a durable latest-state lease after returning the object.
source_observations.consequence: The only plausible product value for data_version is detecting that a previously observed load/use context became stale between bounded stages; it cannot make that boundary race-free by itself.

source_observations.finding: WP901 now opens one SQLite read transaction, invokes WP206 load_checkpoint, re-reads the exact checkpoint row in the same snapshot, validates row/store bindings and mints deterministic row_evidence_sha256 before G3/G2 continuation planning.
source_observations.consequence: The principal restart/recovery source-authentication consumer now already has a stronger transaction-bound snapshot mechanism. EXTERNAL_SQLITE_REVISION_FENCE must not duplicate this path. Same-inode live-drift remains explicitly unclaimed, but its remaining product surface is narrower than before this Trigger-6 run.

sqlite_primary_source_interpretation: Separate connections see only complete committed transactions under normal isolation.
WAL read transactions are snapshot-isolated; later writer commits remain invisible until the reader starts a new read transaction.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE establishes a write transaction and serializes competing writers.
data_version reports other-connection commits on one observer connection but does not create a lock, lease, snapshot identity or race-free latest-state guarantee.

candidate_disposition.reason: Existing evidence proves same-inode drift observability, but current write/recovery paths already use strong SQLite transactions and WP901 G4 now has same-snapshot exact-row attestation. A broad WP206 data_version fence risks redundant checks and false revalidation under unrelated UnifiedDB churn.
candidate_disposition.retire_if: Exact-current E4 shows every authority-sensitive consumer either acts inside the existing write/recovery transaction or consumes a snapshot-bound row attestation/generation fence that already detects relevant staleness.
candidate_disposition.promote_if: Exact-current E4 reproduces a remaining generic load-to-use stale continuation outside those protected paths and the bounded revision-hint plus targeted revalidation closes that exact case without false rejection under unrelated writes.

recommended_e4_matrix: WRITE path: external commit before BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> baseline must see current state inside the transaction; candidate should add no value.
RECOVERY path: external commit before BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> baseline must re-read current row/CAS; candidate should add no value.

WP901 G4 path: external commit before its read transaction -> new snapshot should see it; external commit during the snapshot -> row evidence remains internally snapshot-consistent and must not be misrepresented as latest-state lease.

GENERIC LOAD-USE race outside WP901: external protected mutation after load return but before an authority-sensitive downstream action -> determine whether another generation/attestation/effect gate catches staleness.
UNRELATED LOAD-USE control: external unrelated write after load -> no global rejection after exact protected evidence revalidation.
SAME-CONNECTION control: data_version blind spot remains explicit.
next_exact_action: Trigger4 must first enumerate authority-sensitive consumers of raw CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore.load_checkpoint outside the now-accepted WP901 G4 snapshot-attested ingress. Run the data_version ablation only on a real remaining load-to-use boundary; do not add the hint to write_checkpoint, G4 legacy recovery or WP901 G4 by default.
